title: Những giờ nhung
about: Round 41, thu-vien ("tôi thấy không hay, bạn hãy sáng tác theo ý của bạn và dùng bộ sound phù hợp"), Nocturnes for an Old Library, Velvet Hours: the soft, slow hours of the night, F# minor at 54 bpm (written again: the first, a slow chorale in C minor, was too still): a singing line falling from C# to F#, answered a third higher from F#5, the left hand rocking in the middle (texture flow); the middle in A major. The piano alone, on thu-vien (ke-chuyen-gan's grand, hall and echo, with nothing heavy: no Rhodes, the lows not lifted, the left hand from C3 with no octave); a singing line in periods, a question and an answer, each return varied; soft, a gentle swell in the middle, no climax. An original tune.
